dedupe_keys.name: global urban heat island uhi data set 2013 nasa sedac

description: This NASA SEDAC dataset estimates how much hotter urban areas were than their rural surroundings in the summer of 2013, for urban extents worldwide. For each urban extent from the Global Rural-Urban Mapping Project it gives average summer daytime maximum and nighttime minimum land surface temperature and the difference from a 10 km rural buffer, using MODIS Aqua eight-day land surface temperature composites for a 40-day window in July and August in the northern hemisphere and the matching season in the south. Coverage: global urban extents. Access: free through NASA Earthdata Search, which needs a free Earthdata login to download, with documentation and map services; DOI 10.7927/H4H70CRF. Licence: CC BY 4.0. Caveats: land surface temperature, not air temperature; one summer only; urban extents date from GRUMP version 1 and are coarse. Simulation uses are screening which cities have the strongest surface heat islands for heat exposure of buildings and public spaces, and baselines for cooling interventions. Related records: the global UHI intensity dataset of Yang and the global heat wave exposure due to UHI dataset.
